background.$description: shadcn --background compatibility alias. Maps the semantic default surface to the shadcn variable name expected by shadcn/ui components.

foreground.$description: shadcn --foreground compatibility alias. Maps primary text color to the shadcn variable name.

card.$description: shadcn --card compatibility alias. Cards use the subtle surface (slightly off-white / dark mist) rather than pure default to create visual separation.

card-foreground.$description: shadcn --card-foreground compatibility alias. Reuses default text color for card content.

popover.$description: shadcn --popover compatibility alias. Popovers use the elevated surface token to convey depth above the page.

popover-foreground.$description: shadcn --popover-foreground compatibility alias. Reuses default text color for popover content.

primary.$description: shadcn --primary compatibility alias. Maps the brand action background to the shadcn primary slot.

primary-foreground.$description: shadcn --primary-foreground compatibility alias. Maps the on-action foreground to the shadcn primary-foreground slot.

secondary.$description: shadcn --secondary compatibility alias. The secondary variant shares the subtle surface token rather than a palette of its own.

secondary-foreground.$description: shadcn --secondary-foreground compatibility alias. Secondary text uses default text color for legibility.

muted.$description: shadcn --muted compatibility alias. Muted areas share the subtle surface token.

muted-foreground.$description: shadcn --muted-foreground compatibility alias. Muted foreground maps to the semantic subtle text token.

accent.$description: shadcn --accent compatibility alias. Accent hover states share the subtle surface token with muted areas.

accent-foreground.$description: shadcn --accent-foreground compatibility alias. Accent foreground uses default text for contrast.

destructive.$description: shadcn --destructive compatibility alias. Maps the semantic error token to the shadcn destructive slot.

destructive-foreground.$description: shadcn --destructive-foreground compatibility alias. Text and icons on a solid destructive surface.

border.$description: shadcn --border compatibility alias. Maps the semantic default border to the shadcn border slot.

input.$description: shadcn --input compatibility alias. Maps the semantic input border to the shadcn input slot for form field outlines.

ring.$description: shadcn --ring compatibility alias. Maps the semantic focus ring to the shadcn ring slot.

radius.$description: shadcn --radius compatibility alias. Maps to radius.lg (= radius.base = 0.625rem). No component reads it: radix-lyra draws every component with rounded-none.

chart-1.$description: shadcn --chart-1 compatibility alias. Maps the semantic chart series 1 token.

chart-2.$description: shadcn --chart-2 compatibility alias. Maps the semantic chart series 2 token.

chart-3.$description: shadcn --chart-3 compatibility alias. Maps the semantic chart series 3 token.

chart-4.$description: shadcn --chart-4 compatibility alias. Maps the semantic chart series 4 token.

chart-5.$description: shadcn --chart-5 compatibility alias. Maps the semantic chart series 5 token.

sidebar.$description: shadcn --sidebar compatibility alias. Maps the semantic sidebar background token.

sidebar-foreground.$description: shadcn --sidebar-foreground compatibility alias. Maps the semantic sidebar foreground token.

sidebar-primary.$description: shadcn --sidebar-primary compatibility alias. Maps the active/primary sidebar item color.

sidebar-primary-foreground.$description: shadcn --sidebar-primary-foreground compatibility alias. Maps the on-primary sidebar text; the name mismatch (primary-foreground vs primary.on) is why this bridge is needed.

sidebar-accent.$description: shadcn --sidebar-accent compatibility alias. Maps the sidebar hover/accent surface token.

sidebar-accent-foreground.$description: shadcn --sidebar-accent-foreground compatibility alias. Maps the sidebar accent text token.

sidebar-border.$description: shadcn --sidebar-border compatibility alias. Maps the sidebar border token.

sidebar-ring.$description: shadcn --sidebar-ring compatibility alias. Maps the sidebar focus ring token.
